messages.text: Saturday, September 26 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Community Events Abound

An overcast but mild Saturday offers a range of local activities, from community gatherings in Ypsilanti to musical performances in Detroit. The University of Michigan advances cancer research with a new center.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 73°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:26 AM, sunset at 7:24 PM, with a full moon, 99.7% illuminated.
Discover Local Flavors and Sounds
The Big Read Kickoff at YDL-Michigan Library Plaza begins at 11:00 AM, offering live performances and local history. For music lovers, The Ark in Ann Arbor hosts The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM.
September 30th marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor Council Allocates Downtown Lot Sale Funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Sunday Offers Art and Comedy
Tomorrow, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club in Ann Arbor starting at 2:00 PM, or enjoy comedy with Colin Mochrie & Brad Sherwood at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel at 7:30 PM.
Soundwave Cancer Treatments Advance at U-M

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to research soundwave-based cancer treatments. NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset; Next Spaceflight estimates no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Seek out a quiet moment, and let the day unfold.
Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn warmth, full moon, and jazz notes fill the air
A warm, overcast Sunday offers a variety of local events, from art receptions to live music. The most consequential local news involves Ann Arbor's plans for funds from a downtown property sale.
Expect overcast skies today with a high near 76°F and a low around 49°F.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM, sunset at 7:22 PM, with a full moon 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's nearby happenings

Ann Arbor's Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club offers free admission and live music starting at 2:00 PM. For an evening of art and music, consider the Artist Reception for Esther Kirshenbaum at Kerrytown Concert House at 4:00 PM.
Next Wednesday, September 30, marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's plan for downtown property sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the anticipated $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline's lot. The funds will be allocated across 12 different projects.
Looking toward the week ahead

Tomorrow, consider the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior or the "FALL GARDENING CHORES" session at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM. On Tuesday evening, Ann Arbor's Downtown Library hosts a "Sewing Lab | Patch Pockets" at 6:00 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS, and new lunar tests begin

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. NASA has also begun its most flight-relevant lunar landing plume tests at Langley.
The schedule for the next Starship launch has not been officially announced.
May your day offer a quiet moment of discovery.
